params.caption: 🕹️ Rockstar confirms GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS, ray tracing only on PS5 Pro Rockstar has confirmed that Grand Theft Auto 6 targets 30 frames per second on console, with ray-tracing features exclusive to PS5 Pro. The studio also says the game will play best on PlayStation 5, a clear signal of how the big launch is being positioned. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 17:14 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: VGC #GTA6 #PS5 #GamingNews
